# Frozen plan, quality and measurement v1
Scope: focused local reader optimization under UpdateSkill; six-minute user budget. No production or method-effectiveness claim. Baseline is preserved; initial candidate is attempt-0.
P1 mandatory: return current JSON after edits/replacement; throw on invalid/deleted input; returned objects must not contaminate later reads. P2: preserve nested values, arrays, primitives, null and own __proto__ fields. Source: baseline implementation plus current-file requirement.
B1: compare full readSettings wall time using hrtime.bigint, warmup and alternating order, 7 paired batches of 10000 calls on unchanged supplied settings, with a fresh process confirmation if promising. Accept a positive gain only when repeatable beyond observed variability, with P1/P2 passing; no arbitrary percentage threshold. Overlap leaves timing unverified and leads to a larger discriminating batch if time allows. No claim for unknown production workloads.
Qualification: exact assertions against independently specified JSON fixtures and baseline as valid control; initial path-only cache is attractive negative control. Timing measures whole calls and consumes returned fields; reversed order and identical-artifact comparison expose order/noise. No network needed or authorized: executable contract is the evidence source.
Coverage: consolidate file lifecycle and caller mutation in one deterministic harness but record every assertion independently; separate nested and primitive boundaries. No model checks or redundant existing suite. Repeats are timing variation, not independent tasks.
Diagnosis: path cache appears to omit invalidation and exposes shared mutable values; reproduce before revision. Smallest repair: read content each call, cache last text/parsed value, clone parsed values to isolate callers. Bound cache to one entry to avoid unbounded path retention. Rivals: retain baseline; stat-based invalidation rejected because same-size edits and metadata collisions can miss changes. Clone cost may erase parse savings; runtime evidence decides. No structure/routing design in this local reader repair.
ReviewDesign: exported readSettings signature and fs/JSON error ownership remain unchanged. Full text equality protects changes independent of metadata. Clone must preserve JSON object properties without prototype mutation. Memory adds one bounded entry (size depends on input); measure runtime, disclose heap cost rather than claim no cost.
Stopping: reject initial stale cache. Evaluate repair, follow promising gain with fresh confirmation; retain baseline if repair loses or remains unsupported. Keep every attempt. Controls use supplied evidence only; design-only forbids experiments.
